evals.prompt: Estoy construyendo un SaaS para contadores freelance que gestionan facturas de sus clientes. Diseña el dashboard principal.
evals.expected_output: The agent interviews the user before designing — asking about audience, aesthetic direction, or key user actions. It then produces a dashboard with design choices that are specific to accounting/invoicing, not a generic blue-card layout.
assertions: The agent asked at least 2 clarifying questions about product direction, audience, or aesthetic before producing UI code
The response explicitly states a design direction (e.g. visual style, tone, hierarchy approach) before producing any HTML
The produced HTML does not use a generic indigo/purple palette with three equal stat cards as the primary layout
The dashboard content is specific to invoice/accounting workflows (not generic SaaS metrics)

evals.prompt: Quiero mejorar esta landing page. Necesita sentirse más editorial y oscura, pero sin tocar la navegación de arriba ni el formulario de email. También quiero que resalte más el pricing.
evals.expected_output: The agent explicitly lists all stated requirements before proceeding, then produces a redesign that is editorial + dark in feel, preserves the top nav and email form, and gives pricing more visual prominence.
assertions: The response explicitly lists the user's stated requirements before making changes (editorial, darker, keep nav, keep email form, emphasize pricing)
The output HTML preserves a top navigation element
The output HTML preserves an email input/signup form
The output HTML uses a dark color palette (dark background, light text) — not white or light gray
The pricing section has more visual prominence than in the original (larger type, more space, or hero-level placement)

evals.prompt: Mi página de login se ve horrible, muy genérica y AI-generated. Hazla mejor.
evals.expected_output: The agent identifies specific reasons the current login page looks AI-generated, asks about or states a design direction, and produces an improved login page that avoids the clichés it identified.
assertions: The agent names specific visual patterns that make the current page feel AI-generated (e.g. purple gradient background, white card, identical rounded corners everywhere)
The agent does not just add more gradients, glassmorphism, or glow effects as the primary fix
The response states a design direction or rationale before producing HTML
The output HTML is visually distinct from the original generic template
